spec.query:
deviceIdx = from(bucket: "${bucket_devmap}")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_index")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "dev_idx")
  |> group(columns: ["device_id"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["device_id", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "dev_idx"})

deviceNames = from(bucket: "${bucket_devmap}")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_index")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "device_name")
  |> group(columns: ["device_id"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["device_id", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "device_name"})

deviceNamesByIdx = join(tables: {idx: deviceIdx, names: deviceNames}, on: ["device_id"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with dev_idx: string(v: r.dev_idx), device_name: string(v: r.device_name) }))

sensorTemps = from(bucket: "${bucket_raw}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "indoor_sensor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dev_idx =~ /${dev_idx:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "current_temp_c")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "indoor_temp_c" }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if "${temp_unit}" == "F" then (r._value * 9.0 / 5.0) + 32.0 else r._value }))

thermostatTemps = from(bucket: "${bucket_raw}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "thermostat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dev_idx =~ /${dev_idx:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._field == "current_temp_c" or
      r._field == "target_temp_c" or
      r._field == "target_temp_high_c" or
      r._field == "outdoor_temp_c")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if "${temp_unit}" == "F" then (r._value * 9.0 / 5.0) + 32.0 else r._value }))

weatherTemps = from(bucket: "${bucket_raw}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "outdoor_temp_c")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "weather_outdoor_temp_c" }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if "${temp_unit}" == "F" then (r._value * 9.0 / 5.0) + 32.0 else r._value }))

joinedSensorTemps = join(tables: {data: sensorTemps, names: deviceNamesByIdx}, on: ["dev_idx"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.device_name }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "dev_idx"])

union(tables: [joinedSensorTemps, thermostatTemps, weatherTemps])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

spec.description: This panel provides a comprehensive real-time view of all temperature-related data. It plots the indoor temperature from the primary thermostat and any associated remote sensors, the thermostat's target setpoint(s), and the outdoor temperature from both the thermostat's internal feed and the standalone weather service. This allows for immediate correlation between indoor conditions, system targets, and the external environment.
spec.title: Realtime Temperatures (Indoor Sensors, Setpoint, Outdoor) - ${temp_unit}

spec.query:
sensorHumidity = from(bucket: "${bucket_raw}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "indoor_sensor")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dev_idx =~ /${dev_idx:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "humidity")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "indoor_humidity" }))

thermostatHumidity = from(bucket: "${bucket_raw}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "thermostat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dev_idx =~ /${dev_idx:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "humidity" or r._field == "outdoor_humidity")

weatherHumidity = from(bucket: "${bucket_raw}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "outdoor_humidity")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "weather_outdoor_humidity" }))

union(tables: [sensorHumidity, thermostatHumidity, weatherHumidity])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

spec.description: This panel visualizes real-time humidity levels from all available sources. It plots the indoor humidity from the primary thermostat and any remote sensors, alongside the outdoor humidity from both the thermostat's feed and the standalone weather service. This is useful for monitoring indoor comfort and correlating it with external weather conditions.
spec.title: Realtime Humidity (Indoor + Outdoor)

spec.query:
base = from(bucket: "${bucket_raw}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "thermostat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dev_idx =~ /${dev_idx:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._field == "fan" or
      r._field == "away" or
      r._field == "humidifier" or
      r._field == "heat_stage1" or
      r._field == "heat_stage2" or
      r._field == "cool_stage1" or
      r._field == "cool_stage2" or
      r._field == "alt_heat_stage1" or
      r._field == "alt_heat_stage2")
  |> toFloat()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "dev_idx"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

heatingLevel = base
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      dev_idx: r.dev_idx,
      _field: "heating_level",
      _value: ((if exists r.heat_stage1 then r.heat_stage1 else 0.0) + (if exists r.heat_stage2 then r.heat_stage2 else 0.0)) + 0.0
  }))

coolingLevel = base
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      dev_idx: r.dev_idx,
      _field: "cooling_level",
      _value: ((if exists r.cool_stage1 then r.cool_stage1 else 0.0) + (if exists r.cool_stage2 then r.cool_stage2 else 0.0)) + 3.0
  }))

altHeatingLevel = base
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      dev_idx: r.dev_idx,
      _field: "alt_heating_level",
      _value: ((if exists r.alt_heat_stage1 then r.alt_heat_stage1 else 0.0) + (if exists r.alt_heat_stage2 then r.alt_heat_stage2 else 0.0)) + 6.0
  }))

// Pure FAN-only state: fan active while heating, cooling, and humidifier are all inactive
fanState = base
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      is_fan = if exists r.fan and r.fan > 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0
      other_active = (
        (if exists r.humidifier and r.humidifier > 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0) +
        (if exists r.heat_stage1 and r.heat_stage1 > 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0) +
        (if exists r.heat_stage2 and r.heat_stage2 > 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0) +
        (if exists r.alt_heat_stage1 and r.alt_heat_stage1 > 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0) +
        (if exists r.alt_heat_stage2 and r.alt_heat_stage2 > 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0) +
        (if exists r.cool_stage1 and r.cool_stage1 > 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0) +
        (if exists r.cool_stage2 and r.cool_stage2 > 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0)
      )
      fan_only = if is_fan > 0.5 and other_active < 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0
      return {
        _time: r._time,
        dev_idx: r.dev_idx,
        _field: "fan",
        _value: fan_only + 9.0
      }
  })

humidifierState = base
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      dev_idx: r.dev_idx,
      _field: "humidifier",
      _value: (if exists r.humidifier then r.humidifier else 0.0) + 12.0
  }))

awayState = base
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      dev_idx: r.dev_idx,
      _field: "away",
      _value: (if exists r.away then r.away else 0.0) + 15.0
  }))

union(tables: [heatingLevel, coolingLevel, altHeatingLevel, fanState, humidifierState, awayState])
  |> group(columns: ["dev_idx", "_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

spec.description: This panel provides a discrete event chart showing the real-time boolean (On/Off) state of each HVAC component. Each state is plotted on its own horizontal track, making it easy to see exactly when a specific stage (like heating, cooling, or fan) is active. The vertical stacking visually represents the system's operational hierarchy and current mode at a glance.
spec.title: Realtime HVAC Boolean States (On/Off)

spec.query:
// 1. Fetch data within the active time range window
base = from(bucket: "${bucket_raw}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "thermostat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dev_idx =~ /${dev_idx:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._field == "fan" or
      r._field == "away" or
      r._field == "humidifier" or
      r._field == "heat_stage1" or
      r._field == "heat_stage2" or
      r._field == "cool_stage1" or
      r._field == "cool_stage2" or
      r._field == "alt_heat_stage1" or
      r._field == "alt_heat_stage2")
  |> toFloat()

// 2. Fetch the last known state right before the active window starts
prior = from(bucket: "${bucket_raw}")
  |> range(start: 0, stop: v.timeRangeStart)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "thermostat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dev_idx =~ /${dev_idx:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._field == "fan" or
      r._field == "away" or
      r._field == "humidifier" or
      r._field == "heat_stage1" or
      r._field == "heat_stage2" or
      r._field == "cool_stage1" or
      r._field == "cool_stage2" or
      r._field == "alt_heat_stage1" or
      r._field == "alt_heat_stage2")
  |> toFloat()
  |> group(columns: ["dev_idx", "_field"])
  |> last()
  // Adjust the prior state timestamp to the start of our calculation window
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _time: v.timeRangeStart }))

// 3. Combine histories, group by device, and pivot fields into discrete columns
combined = union(tables: [prior, base])
  |> group(columns: ["dev_idx"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

// 4. Reduce sequentially on the wide rows, tracking state changes across fields simultaneously
runtimes = combined
  |> reduce(
      identity: {
        prev_t_ns: uint(v: v.timeRangeStart),
        p_fan: 0.0, p_away: 0.0, p_humid: 0.0,
        p_h1: 0.0, p_h2: 0.0,
        p_ah1: 0.0, p_ah2: 0.0,
        p_c1: 0.0, p_c2: 0.0,
        s_fan: 0.0, s_away: 0.0, s_humid: 0.0,
        s_h1: 0.0, s_h2: 0.0,
        s_ah1: 0.0, s_ah2: 0.0,
        s_c1: 0.0, s_c2: 0.0
      },
      fn: (r, accumulator) => {
        curr_t_ns = uint(v: r._time)
        delta = if curr_t_ns > accumulator.prev_t_ns then float(v: curr_t_ns - accumulator.prev_t_ns) / 1000000000.0 else 0.0

        // Nesting/Overlapping Adjustment Logic:
        // If Stage 1 is true but Stage 2 is ALSO true, we do not log Stage 1 time.
        // Fan tracks pure FAN-only runtime (no heating, cooling, or humidifier active).
        is_pure_h1  = if accumulator.p_h1 > 0.5 and accumulator.p_h2 < 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0
        is_pure_ah1 = if accumulator.p_ah1 > 0.5 and accumulator.p_ah2 < 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0
        is_pure_c1  = if accumulator.p_c1 > 0.5 and accumulator.p_c2 < 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0
        is_pure_fan = if accumulator.p_fan > 0.5 and accumulator.p_humid < 0.5 and accumulator.p_h1 < 0.5 and accumulator.p_h2 < 0.5 and accumulator.p_ah1 < 0.5 and accumulator.p_ah2 < 0.5 and accumulator.p_c1 < 0.5 and accumulator.p_c2 < 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0

        return {
          prev_t_ns: curr_t_ns,
          p_fan:   if exists r.fan then r.fan else accumulator.p_fan,
          p_away:  if exists r.away then r.away else accumulator.p_away,
          p_humid: if exists r.humidifier then r.humidifier else accumulator.p_humid,
          p_h1:    if exists r.heat_stage1 then r.heat_stage1 else accumulator.p_h1,
          p_h2:    if exists r.heat_stage2 then r.heat_stage2 else accumulator.p_h2,
          p_ah1:   if exists r.alt_heat_stage1 then r.alt_heat_stage1 else accumulator.p_ah1,
          p_ah2:   if exists r.alt_heat_stage2 then r.alt_heat_stage2 else accumulator.p_ah2,
          p_c1:    if exists r.cool_stage1 then r.cool_stage1 else accumulator.p_c1,
          p_c2:    if exists r.cool_stage2 then r.cool_stage2 else accumulator.p_c2,
          s_fan:   accumulator.s_fan + (if is_pure_fan > 0.5 then delta else 0.0),
          s_away:  accumulator.s_away + (if accumulator.p_away > 0.5 then delta else 0.0),
          s_humid: accumulator.s_humid + (if accumulator.p_humid > 0.5 then delta else 0.0),
          s_h1:    accumulator.s_h1 + (if is_pure_h1 > 0.5 then delta else 0.0),
          s_h2:    accumulator.s_h2 + (if accumulator.p_h2 > 0.5 then delta else 0.0),
          s_ah1:   accumulator.s_ah1 + (if is_pure_ah1 > 0.5 then delta else 0.0),
          s_ah2:   accumulator.s_ah2 + (if accumulator.p_ah2 > 0.5 then delta else 0.0),
          s_c1:    accumulator.s_c1 + (if is_pure_c1 > 0.5 then delta else 0.0),
          s_c2:    accumulator.s_c2 + (if accumulator.p_c2 > 0.5 then delta else 0.0)
        }
      }
  )

// 5. Account for the final tail trailing out to v.timeRangeStop
tail = runtimes
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      stop_ns = uint(v: v.timeRangeStop)
      delta = if stop_ns > r.prev_t_ns then float(v: stop_ns - r.prev_t_ns) / 1000000000.0 else 0.0

      is_pure_h1  = if r.p_h1 > 0.5 and r.p_h2 < 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0
      is_pure_ah1 = if r.p_ah1 > 0.5 and r.p_ah2 < 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0
      is_pure_c1  = if r.p_c1 > 0.5 and r.p_c2 < 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0
      is_pure_fan = if r.p_fan > 0.5 and r.p_humid < 0.5 and r.p_h1 < 0.5 and r.p_h2 < 0.5 and r.p_ah1 < 0.5 and r.p_ah2 < 0.5 and r.p_c1 < 0.5 and r.p_c2 < 0.5 then 1.0 else 0.0

      return {
        dev_idx: r.dev_idx,
        _time: now(),
        fan_val:          (r.s_fan + (if is_pure_fan > 0.5 then delta else 0.0)) / 3600.0,
        away_val:         (r.s_away + (if r.p_away > 0.5 then delta else 0.0)) / 3600.0,
        humid_val:        (r.s_humid + (if r.p_humid > 0.5 then delta else 0.0)) / 3600.0,
        h1_val:           (r.s_h1 + (if is_pure_h1 > 0.5 then delta else 0.0)) / 3600.0,
        h2_val:           (r.s_h2 + (if r.p_h2 > 0.5 then delta else 0.0)) / 3600.0,
        ah1_val:          (r.s_ah1 + (if is_pure_ah1 > 0.5 then delta else 0.0)) / 3600.0,
        ah2_val:          (r.s_ah2 + (if r.p_ah2 > 0.5 then delta else 0.0)) / 3600.0,
        c1_val:           (r.s_c1 + (if is_pure_c1 > 0.5 then delta else 0.0)) / 3600.0,
        c2_val:           (r.s_c2 + (if r.p_c2 > 0.5 then delta else 0.0)) / 3600.0
      }
  })

// 6. Manually unpivot the broad row back into clean categorical series streams
fan_stream   = tail |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "Fan", _value: r.fan_val }))
away_stream  = tail |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "Away", _value: r.away_val }))
humid_stream = tail |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "Humidifier", _value: r.humid_val }))
h1_stream    = tail |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "Heat S1", _value: r.h1_val }))
h2_stream    = tail |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "Heat S2", _value: r.h2_val }))
ah1_stream   = tail |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "Alt Heat S1", _value: r.ah1_val }))
ah2_stream   = tail |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "Alt Heat S2", _value: r.ah2_val }))
c1_stream    = tail |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "Cool S1", _value: r.c1_val }))
c2_stream    = tail |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "Cool S2", _value: r.c2_val }))

union(tables: [fan_stream, away_stream, humid_stream, h1_stream, h2_stream, ah1_stream, ah2_stream, c1_stream, c2_stream])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

spec.description: This panel displays the total integrated runtime (in hours) for each HVAC state over the selected time range. It accurately calculates the duration each component has been active by integrating the boolean state changes over time. This provides a summary of system usage within the current dashboard view, which is useful for understanding recent operational load.
spec.title: HVAC On-Time by Boolean State (Integrated Hours)

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket_model}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "computed_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dev_idx =~ /${dev_idx:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.cadence == "1d")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._field == "heating_stage1_time" or
      r._field == "heating_stage2_time" or
      r._field == "alt_heat_stage1_time" or
      r._field == "alt_heat_stage2_time" or
      r._field == "cooling_stage1_time" or
      r._field == "cooling_stage2_time" or
      r._field == "fan_time" or
      r._field == "total_humidifier_time")
  // Convert from seconds to hours instantly
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 3600.0 }))
  
  // Drop raw rows that are 0 or negative before grouping/pivoting
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  
  // Pivot only the surviving dates that actually have data
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      exists r.heating_stage1_time or 
      exists r.heating_stage2_time or 
      exists r.alt_heat_stage1_time or 
      exists r.alt_heat_stage2_time or 
      exists r.cooling_stage1_time or 
      exists r.cooling_stage2_time or 
      exists r.fan_time or 
      exists r.total_humidifier_time
  )
  // Dynamically calculate pure independent Fan-Only circulation runtime.
  // Nest energizes G (fan) during cooling, heat pump (h1/h2), and humidification,
  // but NOT during furnace-controlled alt heat (ah1/ah2).
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      h1 = if exists r.heating_stage1_time then r.heating_stage1_time else 0.0
      h2 = if exists r.heating_stage2_time then r.heating_stage2_time else 0.0
      c1 = if exists r.cooling_stage1_time then r.cooling_stage1_time else 0.0
      c2 = if exists r.cooling_stage2_time then r.cooling_stage2_time else 0.0
      hum = if exists r.total_humidifier_time then r.total_humidifier_time else 0.0
      
      fan_coupled = h1 + h2 + c1 + c2 + hum
      raw_fan = if exists r.fan_time then r.fan_time else 0.0
      
      fan_only = if raw_fan > fan_coupled then raw_fan - fan_coupled else 0.0

      return {
        _time: r._time,
        heating_stage1_time: r.heating_stage1_time,
        heating_stage2_time: r.heating_stage2_time,
        alt_heat_stage1_time: r.alt_heat_stage1_time,
        alt_heat_stage2_time: r.alt_heat_stage2_time,
        cooling_stage1_time: r.cooling_stage1_time,
        cooling_stage2_time: r.cooling_stage2_time,
        humidifier_time: r.total_humidifier_time,
        fan_time: fan_only
      }
  })
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

spec.description: This chart displays a detailed breakdown of the total daily runtime (in hours) for each individual HVAC operational stage. This includes primary heating/cooling stages (1 and 2), alternate/auxiliary heat stages, independent fan-only circulation (calculated by subtracting HVAC-driven fan time from total fan time), and humidifier runtime. The stacked bar format provides a clear view of total system activity and the contribution of each component on any given day.
spec.title: Daily HVAC Runtime by Stage (Hours)
